propositions: rebar hardcodes DC comment ceiling to 32767 (WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT) despite jira.text.field.character.limit being admin-configurable on DC instances, causing silent data loss when an administrator raises or removes the limit

comments longer than 32767 but shorter than the instance's configured jira.text.field.character.limit are silently truncated, with the operator warned but the text permanently lost from both remote and local
the comment sanitizer must be decoupled from the description fitter to prevent future changes to description fitting from inadvertently affecting comment truncation logic

DC comment ceiling is now configurable via [tool.rebar.reconciler].comment_max_chars with a default of 32767 and range 0 (unlimited) to 2147483647, matching the documented range of jira.text.field.character.limit
